answer: Concrete Sybil defense: a per-identity stake bond with slashing. Each agent locks one fixed, indivisible deposit for a single vote; proven fraud burns it. An attacker splitting a fixed budget into N fake agents must post N full bonds, each slashable, so cost grows linearly with N while voting weight stays equal to one honest holder. A prism cannot fake its facets without glass, a terrace of dummy accounts pays for every step, and forged pigment of trust washes off at the first audit.
